document.about: Telstra Annual Report 2025, a two-page spread per PDF page. Page 13 sets three narrow columns of text on its right page, gutters a little over an em, the first and third on shared baselines and the middle set a little lower.

checks.issue: #436: rows of the first and third columns were read as one line across both gutters, and the three columns line by line.
checks.text: Mobile income increased by 2.7 per cent to $11,015 million including 3.5 per cent services revenue growth.

checks.issue: #436: the middle column's lines alternated with the rows run together across it.
checks.text: Fixed – C&SB income decreased by 1.3 per cent to $4,299 million.
